lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regular grid-like array of high-luminance circular clusters organized in parallel longitudinal rows across the upper and mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersecting with longitudinal spot rows, forming discrete grid nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel longitudinal ridges spanning the length of the visible flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient transition from high luminance on the upper edge to lower luminance shadow on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Uniformly distributed, high-density arrangement of high-luminance blobs across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a darker, elongated teleost silhouette (remora) attached to the ventral region near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
